summary: Beazer Homes USA filed an 8-K reporting that stockholders approved the August 6, 2026 merger agreement with Dream Finders Homes and merger sub Bulldogs Merger Sub. At an October 15 special meeting, 21,541,108 votes favored adoption versus 12,898 against; the advisory compensation proposal passed 17,294,632 to 4,275,714, with 80.90% of votes represented. Beazer is the target; terms were not restated in this excerpt, so price and premium remain unknown. The deal still requires customary closing conditions, and the arb angle centers on timing and any regulatory conditions before the merger closes.
